issue_context.title: [Feature] implement happy eyeballs for API testing
issue_context.body: After switching from  Node.js 16 to 18 API tests started failing in Java because it only binds ipv4 127.0.0.1 and node resolves localhost to ::1 by default. To mitigate that we'd like to implement happy eyeballs on our end before node itself fixes it (see https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/41625).

review_comments: let's put them in a Set so that we don't call `socket.destroy()` twice
